;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**A suicide bomb attack at a [[Shia Islam|Shi'ite]] [[mosque]] in [[Gardez]], [[Afghanistan]], kills at least 29 people and wounds at least 40 others. There is no immediate claim for the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack/suicide-bomb-attack-on-afghan-shiite-mosque-kills-25-idUSKBN1KO1DF (Reuters)] [https://tribune.com.pk/story/1772696/3-suicide-attack-hits-inside-eastern-afghanistan-mosque-officials/ (''The Express Tribune'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Vietnam floods]]
**Floods in [[Vietnam]] trigger landslides that kill six people, and leave two injured and five missing. [https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/landslides-kill-6-leave-5-missing-in-northern-vietnam-3787386.html (''VnExpress'')]
*21 people are killed after a boat capsizes in [[Nigeria]]'s northwestern state of [[Sokoto]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-08/03/c_137366613.htm (Xinhua)]

;Health and environment
*Researchers at the [[University of Texas Medical Branch]] in [[Galveston]] report the first successful transplant of a bio-engineered lung. The lung, taken from a donor pig, was reduced to a protein scaffold, and replaced with the subject pig's own cells over the course of a month. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-45046674 (BBC)]
*[[Phase-out of lightweight plastic bags]]
**[[Chile]] becomes the first [[Latin America]]n country to ban the commercial use of single-use [[plastic shopping bag|plastic bag]]s. [https://news.sky.com/story/chile-becomes-first-latin-america-country-to-ban-commercial-use-of-plastic-bags-11459717 (Sky News)]
*[[North Korea]] warns that the heat wave affecting the [[Korean peninsula]] could damage important food crops and lead to shortages. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45062431 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]], Aftermath of the [[2018 North Korea–United States summit]]
**[[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] states in an interview that [[North Korea]]n leader [[Kim Jong-un]] will ultimately set the timeline for denuclearization. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pompeo-says-north-korea-will-set-denuclearization-timeline/ (CBS News)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] imposes sanctions on a [[List of banks in Russia|Russian bank]] that facilitated a transaction for a [[North Korea]]n on an American blacklist. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-sanctions/u-s-issues-fresh-north-korea-related-sanctions-statement-idUSKBN1KO1WH (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Harvey Weinstein sexual abuse allegations]]
**Attorneys for [[Harvey Weinstein]] seek to throw out sexual assault charges against him. [https://newyork.cbslocal.com/2018/08/03/weinsteins-lawyer-seeks-to-dismiss-sex-assault-charges/ (New York CBS Local)]
*[[Yazidis|Yazidi]] demonstrators at [[Calgary City Hall]] in [[Calgary]], [[Alberta]] call for the [[Government of Canada|Canadian government]] to help with efforts to reunite family members in [[Canada]] who fled the genocide perpetrated by [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] in [[Northern Iraq offensive (August 2014)|2014]] with those still living in [[Iraq]]. [https://calgaryherald.com/news/local-news/these-are-traumatized-people-demonstrators-call-on-canadian-government-to-reunite-yazidi-families (''Calgary Herald'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Zimbabwean general election, 2018]]
**The [[Zimbabwe Electoral Commission]] declares [[Emmerson Mnangagwa]] of the ruling [[ZANU–PF]] party the winner of [[Zimbabwe]]'s 2018 presidential election. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/02/mnangagwas-zanu-pf-on-track-to-pull-off-narrow-win-in-zimbabwe-election (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Deportation and removal from the United States]]
**The wife of a former [[United States Marine Corps|US Marine]] and [[Iraq War]] veteran whose family publicly pleaded for [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] to intervene is [[List of people deported or removed from the United States|deported]] to [[Mexico]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/latino/iraq-war-veteran-s-wife-faces-deportation-friday-family-asks-n897031 (NBC News)]
*[[Cabinet of Greece]]
**Greek Civil Protection Minister [[Nikos Toskas]] resigns after a [[2018 Attica wildfires|wildfire]] that killed 88 people and led to wide criticism of the government for its handling of the disaster. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-greece-wildfire-minister-resignation/greek-civil-protection-minister-quits-after-killer-wildfire-idUSKBN1KO23X (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[NASA]]'s [[Jet Propulsion Laboratory]] releases a report officially disclosing a [[meteor]] explosion of roughly 2.1 kilotons of force near [[Thule Air Base]] in northwest [[Greenland]] on July 25. The [[United States Air Force]] confirms the explosion, adding that it did not impact operations at Thule Air Base. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/meteor-thule-air-base-air-force-asteroid-earth-hans-kristensen-nuclear-missile-russia-fireball-a8476896.html (''The Independent'')]
*The [[Space Needle]] in [[Seattle]] unveils the world's first revolving glass floor. [https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/seattle-space-needle-glass-floor/index.html (CNN)]
